translation_snapshot.source: Win the game without ever setting foot on Maj'Eyal.
translation_snapshot.target: 在从未踏足马基·埃亚尔的情况下通关游戏。

translation_snapshot.source: Freed Derth from the onslaught of the mad Tempest, Urkis.
translation_snapshot.target: 从疯狂的风暴魔导师厄奇斯的猛攻中解救了德斯镇。

translation_snapshot.source: Won ToME by closing the Void portal and letting yourself be killed by Aeryn to prevent your mad patron sun from burning the world in a searing flash.
translation_snapshot.target: 关闭虚空传送门并让自己被艾琳杀死，以阻止你那疯狂的太阳主上在一道灼目的闪光中焚毁世界，通关ToME。

translation_snapshot.source: "Won" ToME by sacrificing yourself for your patron Distant Sun, opening a portal for it to burn and consume the world.
translation_snapshot.target: 以牺牲自己、为你的主上遥远的太阳打开传送门，任其焚烧并吞噬整个世界的方式，"通关"ToME。

translation_snapshot.source: Won ToME thanks to a Sher'tul stopping you at the last moment from opening a portal to your mad patron sun.
translation_snapshot.target: 多亏一名夏·图尔人在最后一刻阻止你开启通往你那疯狂的太阳主上的传送门，你才得以通关ToME。

translation_snapshot.source: Unlocked Archmage class and did over one million cold damage (with any item/talent/class).
translation_snapshot.target: 解锁元素法师职业并造成超过100万寒冷伤害（使用任意物品/技能/职业）。

translation_snapshot.source: #{bold}##GOLD#This is a bonus class for the chaotically inclined. It is by no means balanced, fun or winnable, it is most of all #{italic}#RANDOM#{bold}#.#WHITE##{normal}#
translation_snapshot.target: #{bold}##GOLD#这是为倾向混乱者准备的奖励职业。它绝不平衡，也不保证有趣或能通关；最重要的是，它完全#{italic}#随机#{bold}#。#WHITE##{normal}#

translation_snapshot.source: The Doomed strike from behind a veil of darkness or a host of shadows.
translation_snapshot.target: 末日使者从黑暗帷幕或阴影群的掩护下发动攻击。

translation_snapshot.source: Most Archmagi have been trained in the secret town of Angolwen and possess a unique spell to teleport to it directly.
translation_snapshot.target: 大多数元素法师在一个名叫安格利文的秘密小镇接受训练，并拥有一个直接传送到那里的独特法术。

translation_snapshot.source: Archmagi start with knowledge of many schools of magic. However, they usually refuse to have anything to do with Necromancy.
translation_snapshot.target: 元素法师初始便掌握多个魔法学派的知识。然而，他们通常拒绝与死灵法术有任何关联。
